title: Fix Sketchpad Refresh Reloading New Kit And Diagram Hook Order
description: Investigate semio/sketchpad refresh path. Refreshing the page loads a new kit and triggers a React hook order error in DesignDiagram: Rendered more hooks than during the previous render. Fix end-to-end in existing files and extend existing tests to cover the regression.
summary: Stabilized the standalone sketchpad scope id, fixed hook-order violations during design route hydration, persisted browser kit snapshots through IndexedDB/localStorage fallback, and extended the existing Design browser test to cover reload regression checks.
